output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow that allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.

The freezeAccount function allows the owner to set the freezing status of an arbitrary user, but the logic is incorrect as it does not throw when the owner tries to set the freezing status of a non-contract user.
The setPrices function allows the owner to set the buying and selling prices, but the logic is incorrect as it does not throw when the owner tries to set the prices of non-contract users.
